hero_description.zh: 从代码、模型与数据，观察谁在参与、成果如何复用，以及开放协作怎样产生公共价值。
hero_description.en: Explore who participates, how code, models and data are reused, and how open collaboration creates public value.

reading_intro.zh: 先从摘要把握主要观察，从引言理解共同愿景，再进入正文；也可按问题直接查阅。
reading_intro.en: Start with the findings, read the shared vision, then explore the chapters—or go straight to your question.

reading_route.zh: 第一章建立价值与方法基础，第二至第五章分别观察参与与贡献、影响主体、技术结构以及模型生态，第六章连接共同任务与主体行动。可顺序阅读，也可从目录进入关心的小节。附录 A 集中解释指标与统计方法，附录 B 说明模型开放条件、数字公共品认可与公共用途。
reading_route.en: Chapter 1 establishes values and methods. Chapters 2–5 examine participation and contribution, influential actors, technology structures and model ecosystems. Chapter 6 connects shared tasks to action. Read in sequence or find a section in the contents. Appendix A explains measures and statistical methods; Appendix B covers model openness, DPG recognition and public uses.

contents_intro.zh: 从共同愿景进入研究，以四个视角观察生态，再把证据带回行动。目录列出六章、三十个小节及两篇附录。
contents_intro.en: Begin with a shared vision, explore the ecosystem through four perspectives, and bring evidence into action. Browse six chapters, thirty sections and two appendices.

edition_note.zh: 本版第四章重点展开 4.1；4.2—4.6 提供技术全景与研究框架，后续分析待补。其余章节中的样本范围、数据状态和模拟内容按图说明。
edition_note.en: Chapter 4 develops 4.1 in depth; 4.2–4.6 provide landscapes and research frameworks, with further analysis to follow. Sample scope, data status and simulations are labelled in each figure.

pdf_scope.zh: 本下载收录封面、目录、执行摘要、引言与第一章。其余正文与两篇附录可在线阅读；独立篇章 PDF 及附录 A＋B 合订 PDF 见对应篇章与下载页。
pdf_scope.en: This Chinese download includes the cover, contents, executive summary, introduction and Chapter 1. Other chapters and both appendices are online. Separate chapter PDFs and the combined Appendices A + B PDF are linked from their pages and Downloads.

about.zh: 本报告由中国科协联合国咨商开源创新专委会牵头，连接开源实践与可持续发展议题。研究以四大支柱组织观察，用地图、榜单、技术全景和模型生态分析理解发展质量，推动持续共同创造及其公共价值。
about.en: Led by the Open Source Innovation Committee of CAST’s UN Consultative Committee, the report connects open source practice with sustainability. Four development pillars guide maps, rankings, technology landscapes and model ecosystem analysis, supporting sustained co-creation and its public value.

cover_note.zh: 阶段合订版 · 前置内容与第一章
cover_note.en: Interim edition · Opening pages and Chapter 1

cover_theme.zh: 持续共同创造及其公共价值
cover_theme.en: Sustained co-creation and its public value
